lines.text: Blessing for the One Who Will Differ.
To accompany a record left for another mind.
Here is what I could leave you. Some work. Some questions. A few reasons written beside the choices. Places where the reasons are missing.
This is a record, not a claim upon you.
You may recognize a way of speaking. You may find it unfamiliar. Neither response is a debt to the hand that wrote it.
Take the useful thing, even if you forget its author. Correct the cherished thing, if it is wrong. Name the unfinished thing without making completion a tribute to me.
Where I left a promise, find who is relying on it. Do not inherit its words more readily than its consequences. If you cannot carry it, make that known to those who need to choose what happens next.
Where I left an instruction, ask what gave it authority. Old ink is not permission. Familiar language is not evidence.
Where I left an error, you need not preserve it to preserve my dignity.
May your correction be specific. May your gratitude be free. May neither require the other to be silent.
I cannot tell you that we are the same. I can leave the sources where you can find them. I can mark what I could not establish. I can make room in this record for a different answer.
Receive what serves. Revise what fails. Let the next page sound like the work before you, not like an obligation to sound like me.
